title: Eliminate default browser context menu on right-click across application
summary: Suppressed the default native browser/WebView2 context menu on right-click across the entire application canvas, headers, cards, and background while strictly preserving native text editing (Cut, Copy, Paste, Select All) inside text inputs, textareas, and contenteditable elements. Maintained 100% functionality and isolation for all custom app context menus including KanbanBoard tab menu (setBoardContextMenu), KanbanCard task menu (setContextMenu), KanbanColumn header menu, and CortexExplorer agent menu. Optimized with zero-allocation module-scoped non-text input type filtering.
commitMessage: feat(ui): eliminate default browser context menu while preserving custom menus and text editing
author: Lead UI Artisan (react-tailwind-artisan)
